name: studying
description: Long quiet sessions of reading, homework and exam revision that need steady background music without distracting lyrics.

name: coding
description: Hours of concentrated computer work where a steady, repetitive beat helps you stay in the zone.

name: workout
description: High-intensity exercise such as lifting weights, sprinting or cardio that needs fast, loud, motivating tracks to keep you pushing.

name: sleep
description: Winding down in bed and drifting off, which calls for very slow, very quiet music with no sudden changes.

name: party
description: A crowded room, a dance floor and friends celebrating, where everyone wants loud, danceable, feel-good anthems.

name: driving
description: Time behind the wheel on a commute, highway or road trip, with steady mid-tempo songs that keep you alert without being frantic.

name: unwinding
description: Slowing down after a long day, resting on the couch and letting stress go with warm, gentle songs.

name: dinner
description: Cooking and sharing a meal with conversation, where tasteful, warm background music should never overpower the talking.

name: date night
description: An intimate evening with someone special that suits smooth, tender, slow-dance music.

name: rainy day
description: Grey skies and rain on the window, a time for reflective, soft, slightly sad songs indoors.

name: morning
description: Getting out of bed and starting the day with bright, positive songs that build energy.

name: meditation
description: Stillness, slow breathing and stretching, supported by spacious sounds with almost no beat.

name: breakup
description: Getting through a breakup or missing someone, when you want songs that sit with the hurt.

name: late night
description: The quiet hours after midnight, awake while the city sleeps, with dreamy nocturnal songs.
